source.name: Kelme: Kelme unveils new World Cup kit for Jordanian national team
source.quote: Kelme presents the new kit for the Jordanian National Team

summary: Kelme kit (four-year JFA deal signed May 2026). No commercial shirt sponsor: Kelme's launch images and JFA match photos (2026 World Cup v Argentina, June 2026) show only the Kelme logo, the JFA crest and the FIFA World Cup sleeve patch; the back carries name and number only.
